dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, interlocking 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with jagged, high-contrast light-grey perimeters and dark-centered pixel gradients are distributed across the central dorsal surface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of diffuse light-grey clusters situated between macro-annuli; two highly localized, solid orange-red pixel blocks are visible on the upper-dorsal and posterior regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A non-linear polygonal chain formed by connecting the centroids of the primary dorsal macro-annuli, anchored by the two orange-red high-intensity pixel masses.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two distinct orange-red identifiers are present: one rectangular-shaped mark on the anterior-dorsal region and a smaller, irregular mark on the posterior tail area.
